enDef: to touch someone with your lips as a greeting, to show them love, or as part of a sexual relationship

example.en: Maggie leaned forward and kissed her cheek.
example.cn: 玛吉俯身吻了她的脸颊。

enDef: a child

example.en: She’d always loved animals since she was a little kid.
example.cn: 她从小就喜爱动物。

enDef: the room where you prepare and cook food

example.en: Sam went into the kitchen to make a pot of tea.
example.cn: 萨姆走进厨房去沏一壶茶。

enDef: a kilogram

example.en: This kind of chocolate is retailed at one pound a kilo.
example.cn: 这种巧克力糖零售每公斤一英镑。

enDef: a board with buttons marked with letters or numbers that are pressed to put information into a computer or other machine

example.en: a computer keyboard
example.cn: 计算机键盘

enDef: a small specially shaped piece of metal that you put into a lock and turn in order to lock or unlock a door, start a car etc

example.en: A bunch of keys hung from his belt.
example.cn: 他的皮带上挂着一串钥匙。

enDef: a man who rules a country because he is from a royal family

example.en: On 2 December Henry VI was crowned king (= made the king at an official ceremony ).
example.cn: 12月2日，亨利六世加冕为王。

enDef: the joint that bends in the middle of your leg

example.en: Lucy had a bandage round her knee.
example.cn: 露西的膝盖上缠着绷带。

enDef: If you kick someone or something, you hit them forcefully with your foot

example.en: He kicked the door hard.
example.cn: 他用力踢门。

enDef: to make a person or animal die

example.en: Why did she kill her husband?
example.cn: 她为什么杀死丈夫？

cn: [计量] 公里；[计量] 千米（等于kilometre）

example.en: She had to battle snowstorms, landslides, snakes and loneliness on her 350 kilometer journey.
example.cn: 在350公里的行程中，她要克服暴风雪、滑坡、蛇和孤独寂寞。

enDef: one of the different types of a person or thing that belong to the same group

example.en: Get me a sandwich – any kind will do.
example.cn: 给我一份三明治，随便哪种都可以。

enDef: a light frame covered in coloured paper or plastic that you let fly in the air on the end of one or two long strings

example.en: She has a blue and green kite.
example.cn: 她有一只蓝色和绿色的风筝。

enDef: to hit a door or window with your closed hand to attract the attention of the people inside

example.en: I knocked and knocked but nobody answered.
example.cn: 我把门敲了又敲，但无人回应。

cn: 知识，学问；知道，认识；学科
enDef: the information, skills, and understanding that you have gained through learning or experience

example.en: He did not have much knowledge of American history.
example.cn: 他对美国历史所知不多。

enDef: an Australian animal that moves by jumping and carries its babies in a pouch (= a special pocket of skin ) on its stomach

example.en: What that kangaroo did to this courtyard .
example.cn: 那袋鼠在这院子做了什么。

cn: 热心的； 激烈的； 敏锐的
enDef: someone who is keen is eager to work or learn, and enjoys doing it

example.en: keen students
example.cn: 求知若渴的学生

cn: [kept-kept] 使保持， 使继续； 阻止， 防止； 履行， 遵守； 保存， 保
enDef: to stay in a particular state, condition, or position, or to make someone or something do this

example.en: You can keep it. I don’t need it any more.
example.cn: 你留着吧，我不需要了。

enDef: a metal blade fixed into a handle, used for cutting or as a weapon

example.en: a knife and fork
example.cn: 一副刀叉

cn: [knew-known] 知道， 了解； 认识， 熟悉； 通晓， 会； 认出， 分辨
enDef: to have information about something

example.en: Who knows the answer?
example.cn: 谁知道答案？

cn: [计量] 公里；[计量] 千米
enDef: a unit for measuring distance, equal to 1,000 metres

example.en: ...only one kilometre from the border.
example.cn: …距离边境只有1公里。

enDef: a school for children aged two to five

example.en: I to the kindergarten at the age of three.
example.cn: 在我记忆中，我三岁就被送去幼儿园了。

cn: 监护人；饲养员；看守人；管理人
enDef: someone who looks after animals

example.en: a beekeeper
example.cn: 养蜂人

enDef: a container with a lid, a handle, and a spout,used for boiling and pouring water

example.en: She filled the kettle and switched it on.
example.cn: 她把水壶灌满，打开了开关。

enDef: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 1,000 grams

example.en: By comparison, one kilogram of tomatoes requires 160 litres of water.
example.cn: 相比之下，生产一公斤的番茄需要160升水。

enDef: kind behaviour towards someone

example.en: I can’t thank you enough for your kindness.
example.cn: 你的好意我感激不尽。

enDef: a country ruled by a king or queen

example.en: the United Kingdom
example.cn: 联合王国

example.en: He observes keenly but says very little.
example.cn: 他观察敏锐， 但说得很少。

enDef: to be in or move into a position where your body is resting on your knees

example.en: Tom knelt down and patted the dog.
example.cn: 汤姆跪下来轻轻拍了拍那只狗。

enDef: If you knit something, especially an article of clothing, you make it from wool or a similar thread by using two knitting needles or a machine

example.en: I had endless hours to knit and sew.
example.cn: 我有无数的时间来缝缝织织。

enDef: a round handle or thing that you turn to open a door, turn on a television etc

example.en: He thought the door was locked, but he turned the knob and the door opened.
example.cn: 他本以为门是锁住的，但是转了一下把手门就开了。

enDef: a unit for measuring the speed of ships and aircraft, equal to about 1,853 metres per hour

example.en: One lace had broken and been tied in a knot.
example.cn: 一根带子已经断了，被打成一个结。

enDef: to take someone somewhere illegally by force, often in order to get money for returning them

example.en: Police appealed for wit­nesses after a woman was kidnapped at gunpoint.
example.cn: 一名妇女遭到持枪绑架，警方呼吁目击者挺身而出。

enDef: one of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine

example.en: a kidney transplant
example.cn: 肾脏移植

enDef: a unit for measuring electrical power, equal to 1,000 watts

example.en: a prototype system which produces 25 kilowatts of power
example.cn: 一个生产25千瓦电量的样机

enDef: a man with a high rank in the past who was trained to fight while riding a horse

example.en: knights in armour
example.cn: 身披盔甲的骑士

enDef: relating to movement

example.en: kinetic energy
example.cn: 动能

enDef: to start burning; to make a fire start burning

example.en: We watched as the fire slowly kindled.
example.cn: 我们看着火慢慢地燃烧起来。

enDef: a set of tools, equipment etc that you use for a particular purpose or activity

example.en: Sally keeps her make-up kit in her bag.
example.cn: 萨莉把化妆包放在手提包里。

enDef: the part of a nut or seed inside the shell, or the part inside the stone of some fruits

example.en: The nutshell includes the kernel.
example.cn: 果壳裹着果仁。

enDef: Your kin are your relatives

cn: 拱顶石； 基础， 主旨
enDef: the large central stone in an arch that keeps the other stones in position

example.en: The government's determination to beat inflation has so far been the keystone of its economic policy.
example.cn: 政府对通货膨胀的坚决抑制迄今为止一直是其经济政策的根本。

enDef: Kung fu is a Chinese way of fighting in which people use only their bare hands and feet
